title: Cambodian genocide under the Khmer Rouge
summary: An estimated 1.5 to 2 million people, 20-25% of Cambodia's 1975 population, died under Pol Pot's Khmer Rouge. It targeted former officials, professionals, intellectuals, monks, and Chinese, Cham, Vietnamese and Thai minorities.
why: A Vietnamese invasion ended the regime; a UN-backed tribunal later convicted two Khmer Rouge leaders of genocide.

notes.problem: Source gives 1.5-2 million (20-25%), not 1.2-2.2 million; '7 January 1979' is not on the page (lede: 'By January 1979'); the conviction year differs between sources (verdict Nov 2018, page says 28 March 2019), so drop it.
